name: tools-changed-after-call-keeps-call-spec
description: Crash after effect_begin of an idempotent tool, then the host removed the tool from the set (a valid tools_changed). Recovery classes the pending call by the spec it was made under, not the latest set: it settles safe_to_retry inside the dedup window and re-dispatches with the same effect key, as if the set had not changed.
